leather-bracer-i1.image: Concept art of a single fantasy archer's bracer, a game item, shown alone in three-quarter view and centred on a plain pale grey background. It is an open curved forearm guard, a tapered half-cylinder of worn tan leather, wider at the elbow end and narrower at the wrist, its open inner side turned slightly toward the viewer so the hollow inside is visible; an embossed leaf motif and stitched edges on the outer face; two leather straps with small bronze buckles holding it closed. No arm, no hand, no stand, no other objects. Stylised low-poly toy-miniature look, flat matte colours, soft even lighting, no outlines, no text. Palette: dusty sage, rust, ochre and bone.
